'''Shin Hati's Fiend fighter'''<ref name="Shin Hati DB" /> was an [[RP82 Fiend fighter|RP82 Fiend]] [[starfighter]] that the [[Force-sensitive]] [[mercenary]] [[Shin Hati]] [[pilot]]ed during her [[time]] as a member of [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces]]. Her ally [[Marrok]] piloted<ref name="Part 3" /> a [[Marrok's Fiend fighter|starfighter]]<ref name="Marrok DB">{{Databank|marrok-inquisitor|Marrok (Inquisitor)}}</ref> of the same [[RP82 Fiend fighter|model]] as Hati's Fiend.<ref name="Part 3" />

Around [[9 ABY]]<ref name="9 ABY">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and her [[Mandalorian]] apprentice [[Sabine Wren]] traveled in the ''[[T-6 1974]]'' [[shuttle]] to the [[Denab system]] where the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' was located. In response, [[Morgan Elsbeth]] dispatched Hati in her Fiend fighter to lead a squadron attack on Tano's [[T-6 shuttle]], resulting in a [[Dogfight in the Denab system|dogfight]] near the [[planet]] [[Seatos]].<ref name="Part 3" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shin Hati's starfighter was first pictured in the teaser trailer for ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' in [[April 7]], [[2023]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}}</ref> It was first identified in a [[LEGO]] [[LEGO Star Wars|Star Wars]] set as part of the Summer 2023 wave in the [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic Con]] in [[July 19]] of the same year.<ref name="Lego">{{WebCite|url=https://www.thebrickfan.com/lego-star-wars-sets-announced-at-sdcc-2023|text=LEGO Star Wars Sets Announced at SDCC 2023|author=Allen "Tormentalous" Tran|date=2023-7-19|archivedate=20230720001156}}</ref> It first appeared on screen in the third episode, [[Part Three: Time to Fly|''Time to Fly'']]<ref name="Part 3" /> which premiered in [[August 29]], 2023.<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref>
